findings.label: Connection-backed node never lights
findings.detail: withProviderNodeEntries skips an embeddings/audio node when its node id is already a (connection-keyed) topology entry, without adding the prefix as an alias on that entry. Prefix-keyed lifecycle events then never match. Latent today because the Arc nodes have no connections. Fix: add the prefix to the existing entry's aliases instead of skipping, and update the byId test.

findings.label: Audio finish after post-processing
findings.detail: Speech and transcription routes call live.finish({status:200}) after clearRecoveredProviderState/calculateModalCost/attachOmniRouteMetaToResponse, outside the try. A throw there leaves an unmatched request.started, and useLiveRequests has no TTL, so the node pulses until reload. Finish right after the handler returns, or use try/finally.

findings.label: Speech combos stay dark
findings.detail: executeSpeechCombo returns before beginLiveRequest, so TTS through a combo never lights arc-kokoro. This is in the plan's scope exclusions. Track it as a follow-up.
